content:
We need to extract SMILES of unknown sample. We have many tools: mass spec, NMR, IR, etc. We need to determine structure. Likely we need to run some cheap measurement first. Mass spec gives molecular weight, formula maybe. Then NMR gives clues. But we want efficient minimal experiments.

We can start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and maybe formula. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
